scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @repo/orpc build && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,dump,kit "pnpm --filter @repo/orpc dev" "pnpm --filter @repo/api dev" "pnpm --filter @repo/dump dev" "pnpm --filter heyttpdump-kit dev"
scripts.dev:kit: pnpm --filter @repo/orpc build && concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --filter @repo/orpc dev" "pnpm --filter heyttpdump-kit dev"
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @repo/orpc --filter @repo/api --filter @repo/dump build && pnpm -r check && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
